description: Database utilities can fetch papers and embeddings by category
steps: Run src/db.py with test query for 'reasoning_models'
Verify returns papers with arxiv_code, title, summary
Verify fetch_embeddings returns 3072-dim vectors

description: Hierarchy discovery script batches papers to LLM and identifies natural subgroups
steps: Script fetches ~500 papers from a category
Batches abstracts/summaries to LLM, asks to identify subgroups
Output: proposed subcategories with paper assignments
Reusable for discovering sub-subgroups within subcategories
Iterate with user to validate and refine 2 hierarchy levels

description: Classification script assigns papers to discovered hierarchy with balanced sampling
steps: Takes validated hierarchy as input
Classifies papers into subcategory/sub-subcategory
Applies quotas for balanced dataset (~125 per category)
Outputs data/curated_papers.json with ~500 labeled papers

description: Analysis scripts compute summary statistics on curated dataset — metrics TBD
steps: Define metrics based on research question (during planning)
Implement analysis script for curated dataset
Output summary statistics and initial visualizations

description: Interactive D3.js visualization of hierarchy data (indented tree with bars)
steps: Create viz/ directory with HTML/CSS/JS
Implement indented tree layout with quantitative bars
Add collapse/expand interactivity
Add file selector for all hierarchy files

description: LLM paper selection experiment: compare single-shot vs multi-run selection for finding interesting papers
steps: Sample ~200 recent papers from DB (stratified/filtered by category)
Run single-shot LLM selection (top 5)
Run multi-selection Z times (30 runs)
Analyze frequency distribution and consensus papers
Compare single-shot vs consensus for interestingness
